verdict.rationale: Copilot cloud agent runs tasks in the background on GitHub. A centralized page lets you jump between agent sessions and check progress, and you can steer work by mentioning @copilot on a pull request. Together these imply a cloud-hosted task can be picked up later from GitHub, but cross-device or cross-browser handoff is never stated explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of resuming a session started on one device (e.g. IDE or CLI) from another device or browser, local-to-cloud session handoff, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser

citations.quote: With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
Use one centralized control page to jump between agent sessions, check progress, and stay in control without losing your place.
Mention `@copilot` in a comment on an existing pull request to ask it to make changes.
